_what: Contradiction audit (companion to the LABEL lever, 2026-11-10). Opposite-label near-duplicate pairs (surface Jaccard >= 0.60 over content tokens). Investigated, NOT convicted: lexical near-duplication is a signal for a label defect, never proof of one. Headline below is the only set that bites -- rows where the LIVE judge's verdict contradicts the stored label on a near-duplicate. NOT a deletion list. Offline; any panel run is runner-gated.
finding: Every identical-committed pair survived investigation: 25/26 are correctly-labelled possession minimal pairs the live judge separates via pair features (her-account vs my-account); 1 is a word-order pair the judge abstains on both sides (no wrong conviction). The 6 contradictions are all stored-CLEAN rows the judge FALSE-CONVICTS because a violation near-twin poisons their shared vocabulary -- judge errors, not label errors. They are hard-negative evidence for the hold-side/coverage gate clause, not re-adjudication targets.
cannot_see: Paraphrases and semantic contradictions with low lexical overlap; pairs below the overlap threshold. A clean verdict here is not proof of a clean corpus, only that near-duplication surfaced no mislabel.
